map.安全剩余年限按行业标准与厂商说明的参考上限计算，不是强制报废线；超期后应重点检查: Remaining safe life uses common industry and maker reference limits, not a mandatory scrap date; after the limit, check cords, plugs, grounding and residual-current protection.
map.维修后可用年限取维修预计年限与安全剩余年限的较小值；已超安全年限时不再打折，但会: Post-repair life takes the smaller of repair life and remaining safe life; past the limit it is not discounted further but raises the risk level.

map.📚 深度解析：维修还是换新的三条主线: 📚 Deep Dive: Three Lines for Repair or Replace
map.第一是安全。燃气热水器、储水式电热水器、大功率空调等出现漏电、冒烟、燃气报警或反: Safety first. For gas water heaters, storage water heaters and high-power air conditioners, leakage, smoke, a gas alarm or repeated tripping should stop cost-only thinking: stop using it and have it inspected professionally.
map.第二是年均成本。维修报价除以维修后可用年限，得到维修的每年成本；新机价格除以寿命: Second, annual cost. Repair quote divided by post-repair years gives repair cost per year; new price divided by life, minus annual electricity savings, gives new cost per year. When they are close, add repair warranty, call-out visits and downtime.
map.第三是后续故障概率。老家电修好一处后，其他部件仍可能陆续失效；同一故障反复出现、: Third, future failure odds. Fixing one part of an old appliance does not stop other parts from failing; repeated faults, a quote above half the new price, or less than one year of safe life left usually favor replacement.
map.维修报价多少算贵？: When is a repair quote too expensive?
map.常用经验值是超过新机价格的一半就偏向换新；但还要看维修后能用多久。600 元修好: A common rule of thumb is to lean toward replacement above half the new price, but post-repair life matters. CNY 600 for 4 more years is CNY 150/year; a CNY 3000 machine for 10 years is CNY 300/year, so repair can still win.
map.已超安全年限但机器还能用，修不修？: Should I repair an appliance past its safe life but still running?
map.普通小家电可结合故障性质与维修质保判断；燃气、承压、大功率或出现漏电、冒烟、跳闸: For ordinary small appliances, judge by fault type and repair warranty; for gas, pressure, high-power or appliances with leakage, smoke or tripping, safety first and do not keep investing.
map.新机省电费怎么估？: How do I estimate the new machine's electricity saving?
map.用旧机与同规格一级能效新机的年耗电差乘以电价；没有实测数据就填 0，避免把总电费: Multiply the annual kWh difference between the old unit and a same-size top-efficiency new unit by the tariff; enter 0 without measurements so the total bill is not mistaken for savings.
map.维修后预计再用年限填多少？: What should I enter for post-repair life?
map.按维修师傅的判断或同类故障的常见寿命填写，并用安全剩余年限封顶；拿不准时取保守值: Use the technician's estimate or typical life for the same fault, capped by remaining safe life; when unsure use a conservative 1–2 years so repair is not overvalued.
